title: CAPEX Add-Line Persistence Design Gate
purpose: Design gate for the persistence + backend model contract of user-added CAPEX sub-lines introduced in 57A-8 as in-memory only. This PR is docs/report/test-only. It does NOT implement persistence. The runtime implementation lands in 57A-9B through 57A-9E, gated on review of this design.
stop_after_report: This PR is the final word on the persistence + backend model contract. Do not auto-merge. Do not start 57A-9B / 57A-9C / 57A-9D / 57A-9E before review and explicit go-ahead.

recap_57a8.api_calls: none (no fetch / XHR / htmx.ajax / form.submit / localStorage / sessionStorage)

matrix.q2_project_snapshot_blob: rejected — schema-less in a JSON blob, hard to query

ownership_model.existence_layer: dedicated capex_sub_lines table (single source of truth for what user-added sub-lines exist for this project)
ownership_model.amount_layer: scenario overrides_json blob with reserved keys _capex_sub_line_overrides and _capex_sub_line_overrides_metadata

options.name: option_1_pure_scenario_override_blob
options.reason: Schema-less, hard to query, hard to enforce referential integrity, requires changing Phase 20B silent-drop behavior on the standard flat input fields

options.name: option_2_pure_project_snapshot_blob
options.reason: Kills per-scenario amount variation; propagates schema-less problem to a more-widely-read code path

options.name: option_3_dedicated_table_only_base
options.reason: Requires either a column per scenario (impossible — scenarios are dynamic) or a side column with a JSON blob keyed by scenario_id (re-introduces the schema-less blob problem inside the table)

options.name: option_4_hybrid
options.reason: Only option that satisfies all four hard constraints simultaneously: (1) no new named field on CapexStructure, (2) per-scenario amount variation works, (3) schema-strong existence, (4) minimal Phase 20B blast radius

options.name: option_5_pure_project_template_copy
options.reason: Breaking change to the model; would require re-shaping the model or wrapping the model in an adapter, both of which are out of scope for the persistence design gate

per_category_mapping.purpose: Single point of integration between the user sub-line world and the model world. Maps each C.01..C.16 category to the corresponding CapexStructure field name. Encoded as a constant CAPEX_CATEGORY_TO_FIELD in app/persistence/capex_sub_lines.py (proposed, future runtime PR).

C.17.name: Financing Costs
C.17.note: Read-only; no per-line mapping; sum flows from financing fields (idc_keur, commitment_fees_keur, bank_fees_keur, other_financial_keur, vat_costs_keur)

C.18.name: Reserve Accounts
C.18.note: Read-only; no per-line mapping; sum flows from reserve_accounts_keur

aggregation_rule.formula: effective_amount_keur = base_amount_keur + sum(user_sub_lines for this category, scenario_overrides[sub_line_id] if present else user_sub_lines.default_amount_keur)
aggregation_rule.model_derivation_note: total_capex_keur, sculpt_capex_keur, hard_capex_keur are properties on CapexStructure that sum the 15 named CapexItem.amount_keur fields. Folding user sub-lines into those fields re-derives all sums automatically. No new model code is required.

ddl_outline: sub_line_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE  -- stable UUID; survives soft-delete + re-add
project_id TEXT NOT NULL  -- FK projects.project_id
display_order INTEGER NOT NULL  -- 1, 2, 3, ... per (project_id, parent_category_code)
amount_keur REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0  -- project-level default amount
schedule_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'  -- optional M1-M18 schedule override (future)
is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1  -- soft-delete flag
INDEX idx_capex_sub_lines_project ON capex_sub_lines(project_id, is_active, parent_category_code, display_order)

components.U: literal 'U' prefix marking 'user-added' (vs. template C.NN.NN codes)
components.###: 3-digit zero-padded counter, unique per (project_id, parent_category_code); counter starts at 001 and is assigned by MAX(counter) + 1 on insert

business_code_format.u_prefix_rationale: Disjoint namespace from the template C.NN.NN codes (see 57A-5B canonical catalogue). Prevents collisions with future template changes.
business_code_format.gap_preservation_on_soft_delete: Gaps are preserved on soft-delete: counter continues from MAX(including deleted) + 1. Audit trail remains readable. business_code is NOT the durable identifier; the UUID sub_line_id is. Scenarios override amount by sub_line_id, not by business_code.
business_code_format.hard_delete_handling: Out of scope for 57A-9A. Proposed for 57A-9B: a separate is_hard_deleted flag that releases the business code so it can be reused.

stable_uuid_invariant.rationale: If the user soft-deletes C.02.U001 and creates a new C.02.U001 with a new UUID, the old scenario's override still references the old UUID and silently becomes a no-op. The scenario does not 'follow' the new line. The user can manually re-bind the override if desired (future UX work, not in 57A-9A).

_capex_sub_line_overrides.validation: sub_line_id must be a non-empty string; amount must be a number

update_scenario_overrides_change.behavior: ADDITIVE — add a second allowlist SCENARIO_SUB_LINE_OVERRIDE_KEYS consulted BEFORE the silent-drop check. Existing 22-key flat-path unchanged. Phase 20B invariant preserved for all other keys.

run_integration.helper: _apply_user_sub_lines_to_capex(capex: CapexStructure, user_sub_lines: tuple[CapexSubLine, ...], scenario_overrides: dict[str, dict[str, float]]) -> CapexStructure
run_integration.invocation_point: After scenario resolution, before model invocation (proposed for 57A-9D; verify exact location is part of 57A-9D design verification)
run_integration.factory_safety: Empty user_sub_lines tuple -> capex returned unchanged. Factory projects have no user-added sub-lines -> helper is a no-op. TUHO/Oborovo parity preserved by construction.
run_integration.model_impact: ZERO new model code. The post-fold CapexStructure is a new immutable instance; the existing properties (hard_capex_keur, sculpt_capex_keur, total_capex) re-derive automatically.

excel_export_integration.parameter_used: advanced_capex_line_items (currently unused optional parameter on export_project_to_excel)
excel_export_integration.materialization: Materialize the user sub-lines into a tuple of objects compatible with advanced_capex_line_items, with amount_keur already overridden by the scenario override blob
excel_export_integration.summary_sheet_impact: NONE — build_capex_summary_table reads project_inputs.capex which is already the post-fold structure
excel_export_integration.items_sheet_impact: build_capex_items_table continues to read the 15 named CapexItem fields; user sub-lines appear as additional items in advanced_capex_line_items consumed by the tax / book depreciation sheets

save_load_flow.save_pattern: Soft-delete + re-insert: open transaction, mark existing capex_sub_lines rows is_active=0, insert new rows with is_active=1 and fresh sub_line_id UUIDs, commit
save_load_flow.audit_preservation: Soft-deleted rows are NOT garbage-collected on save; they are kept for replay / governance
save_load_flow.round_trip_invariant: Write project snapshot + sub-lines + scenario overrides, read them back, run the model, get bit-identical results to the in-memory-only state
save_load_flow.validator_helper: validate_sub_line_override_blob(blob: dict) -> dict — raises ValueError on schema errors; returns sanitized copy

governance_audit_replay.writes_through: All capex_sub_lines writes go through app/persistence/capex_sub_lines.py (proposed). Direct SQL from UI / route handlers is forbidden by convention (Phase 53I-2 rule).
governance_audit_replay.replay_metadata_pattern: Phase 51F Parity Guardrails pattern: replay_count incremented on every write, last_replay_at + last_replay_sha stamped
governance_audit_replay.no_go_copy_scanner: Phase 57D scanner will be extended in 57A-9B or 57A-9C to also scan capex_sub_lines
governance_audit_replay.governance_refresh: Phase 53I governance refresh re-run after 57A-9E lands (planned 57A-9F PR)

phase_plan.title: CAPEX Add-Line Persistence Design Gate

phase_plan.notes: Wires the project save / load flow to the new table. Adds the 2-key allowlist extension to update_scenario_overrides. No Run change. No UI change beyond the existing 57A-8 toolbar (which now optionally persists on save).

phase_plan.title: CAPEX Add-Line Run Integration
phase_plan.notes: Adds the _apply_user_sub_lines_to_capex helper, wires it into the scenario resolution path, and verifies the post-fold numbers match the in-memory preview within rounding tolerance.

phase_plan.title: CAPEX Add-Line Excel Export
phase_plan.notes: Materializes the user sub-lines into the existing advanced_capex_line_items parameter. The summary CapEx sheet and the 15-item CapEx_Items sheet pick up the folded amounts automatically.

phase_plan.title: Agent B post-57A-9 governance refresh
phase_plan.notes: Re-runs the Phase 53I governance refresh and the Phase 51F Parity Guardrails extension. Updates the no-go copy scanner (57D) to also scan capex_sub_lines.

phase_plan.title: Sheet-sheet parity gate (TUHO + Oborovo)
phase_plan.notes: Verifies that the post-57A-9F TUHO Baseline and Oborovo Baseline sheets produce bit-identical numbers to the pre-57A-9B baselines, with the new user sub-line code path disabled (no capex_sub_lines rows for those projects).

out_of_scope: tax_depreciation_per_line_override (parameter exists, UX is future arc)
hard_no_go: no_overrides_json_schema_change (additive allowlist only, Phase 20B silent-drop preserved)
no_factory_project_mutation (factory_template + is_readonly=True cannot have user sub-lines; raises PermissionError)
no_57a8_in_memory_preview_regression (toolbar, marker, badge, warning block, preview-only totals all continue to work)
